description: Parking à vélo - Tarn-et-Garonne is a dataset listed in Tarn et Garonne Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Geodatamine. Listes des parkings à vélos du Tarn-et-Garonne extrait d'openstreetmap via le site. Coverage: Tarn-et-Garonne. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are parking, vélo, tarn et garonne. The portal shows 130 records. The portal shows 2020-12-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-82amenagement-fr-portal.
